sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: highlightCrossTag() now correctly highlights a plain-text filter match that spans a comment boundary (e.g. an entity's name into a separate sibling "(comment)" span), joined only by a synthesized/` ` space. Root cause: `String.trim()` strips ` ` identically to regular whitespace, so the connecting text node was dropped and the surviving fragments were joined with no separator, unlike `getCleanColumnText()`'s own unconditional space-joining behavior — the row count narrowed correctly, but the highlight regex never matched inside `highlightCrossTag()` itself.
